Hi all — thanks Elena, and welcome Marcus.

Short note from the SE/technical side on what will make the orientation and the MAP run smoothly: below is a compact checklist I use to validate environment & access prior to handing over eval tokens and test harnesses. I'll attach a markdown checklist after this message.

Technical readiness checklist (summary):
- Data access: sample export (CSV/NDJSON) + representative doc types (pdf/img) and a minimal schema
- Inference surface: example end-to-end request/response shape + target throughput/latency expectations
- Auth & network: VPN or temporary S3 presigned access, IP allowlist, and SSO (if required)
- Compute & model: target model family (LLM variant), expected sequence length, and whether quantized weights are acceptable for the eval
- Evaluation harness: expected metric definitions (precision/recall thresholds, acceptable F1) and sample scoring scripts (if any)
- Rollback/fallback plan: if a particular model variant shows quality regressions, agreed fallback behavior for demos

Proposed times for the 30-min orientation (all times PT):
- Thu Jul 2, 10:00 AM (preferred per Aditya/Elena)
- Thu Jul 2, 3:00 PM
- Fri Jul 3, 9:00 AM

Marcus — if you can share whether there is a dedicated bucket we should request access to, or if you prefer a secure SFTP, that helps our infra team provision quickly.

I'll attach: technical-readiness-checklist.md (small doc) and will bring these items to the sync.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
